title: 第146章 研究成果第145章 彻底的碾压
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
天边逐渐泛起鱼肚白。
邱予脸上难得露出疲惫的神色，不知道的还以为上手做研究的人是他。
没有办法，他得时时刻刻打起十二分的精神跟着夏以苜的操作走。
夏以苜各种操作和处理都很流畅，像是按了倍速，还有许多省略的步骤，不完全集中精力看的话，稍不留神便会被落下。
若是林朔风此刻在现场，定能精准描述出邱予此刻的心情——就像是在上数学课一样。
研究进入了一个相对平缓的阶段，基本上没有什么操作，需要等待一部分结果出来再继续。
邱予终于找到了一个喘息的机会，低下头用袖子擦了擦额头上的汗。
已经汗流浃背了。
然而，等他擦完汗，想继续看夏以苜往下操作的时候。
邱予看着眼前少女犹如坐了火箭一样的速度，人已在风中凌乱。
不是，他刚刚只是擦了个汗，不是去吃了顿饭吧？
谁能告诉他，为什么他才一会儿没看，夏以苜的进度便往前推了这么多？方才她不是还在等结果吗？
邱予的心中有那么亿点点崩溃。
本来就是勉强能跟上夏以苜的节奏，就因为他擦了个汗，此刻就变成和华长老他们完全一样的看不懂了。
邱予脸色黑了黑，难以相信，自己竟然真的会不如一个黄毛丫头。
他长长吐出一口浊气，不经意看向一旁的华长老等人。
两边的人一对视，空气中有种诡异的寂静。
看到邱予脸上的郁色，华长老他们便好像明白了什么。
停顿了片刻，华长老一行人默默往旁边挪了几步，给邱予让出一个位置，对邱予发出邀请。
他们这些看不懂的人都站这边。

邱予拒绝了他们的邀请，并且瞪了他们一眼。
哪怕他现在已经跟不上夏以苜的节奏，能近距离看一下她的操作和思路也是好的。
当然，最主要的是，邱予不愿意承认他和华长老那些人是一个水平。
这是这位太上长老最后的倔强。
到天色完全亮起来的时候，夏以苜停下手中的动作，举手伸了个懒腰。
转头看到邱予还盯着之前她操作的地方，神情愣愣，目光放空，进入了哲学状态。
人话：在发呆。
邱予一开始还是很想认真看的，可这个东西吧，不是他认真看就能看懂的。
如果不能跟上夏以苜的思路，她的那些操作就变得如同干的能噎死人的大饼。
而邱予现在的状态就是被大脑噎得不行了，试图靠放空来让他的脑子缓一缓。
“太上长老？”夏以苜出声，将发呆的邱予吓了一跳。
邱予回过神来，故作镇定道：“咳，怎么了？”
她摸着下巴，目光不断在邱予身上打量着，看得邱予一阵心虚。
“太上长老方才是在……发呆？”夏以苜迟疑着开口，“可太上长老不是说要仔细盯着我研究吗？这又是在做什么？”
“太上长老应该不会又要说没看到我的研究过程吧？”
邱予老脸涨红，若不是夏以苜的神情格外认真，他都要以为这丫头是故意编排他的。
content_en:
The sky gradually turned white.
Qiu Yu rarely showed a tired look on his face, and those who didn't know it thought he was the one who started doing research.
There was no other way, he had to stay alert at all times and follow Xia Yilu's operations.
Xia Yiyou's various operations and processing are very smooth, as if he has pressed the double speed, and there are many omitted steps. If you don't fully concentrate on watching, you will be left behind if you are not careful.
If Lin Shuofeng were at the scene at this moment, he would be able to accurately describe Qiu Yu's mood at this moment - as if he was in a math class.
The research has entered a relatively gentle stage, with basically no operations, and we need to wait for some results to come out before continuing.
Qiu Yu finally found a chance to breathe, lowered his head and wiped the sweat from his forehead with his sleeves.
Already sweating profusely.
However, after he finished wiping his sweat, he wanted to continue watching Xia Yimo's operations.
Qiu Yu watched the girl in front of him move as fast as a rocket, her body already messy in the wind.
No, he just wiped his sweat, didn't he go to have a meal?
Who can tell him why Xia Yihuo's progress has been pushed forward so much after he just stopped watching it for a while? Wasn't she still waiting for the results just now?
Qiu Yu's heart collapsed a little bit.
He could barely keep up with Xia Yiluo's rhythm, but just because he wiped his sweat, he was now as incomprehensible as Elder Hua and the others.
Qiu Yu's face turned dark. He couldn't believe that he was really inferior to a yellow-haired girl.
He let out a long breath and looked at Elder Hua and others aside.
The people on both sides looked at each other, and there was an eerie silence in the air.
Seeing the gloomy look on Qiu Yu's face, Elder Hua and the others seemed to understand something.
After a pause, Elder Hua and his party silently moved a few steps to the side to make room for Qiu Yu and extended an invitation to Qiu Yu.
Those of them who don't understand are on this side.
Qiu Yu rejected their invitation and glared at them.
Even if he can no longer keep up with Xia Yiluo's rhythm, it would be good to have a close look at her operations and thoughts.
Of course, the most important thing is that Qiu Yu is unwilling to admit that he is on the same level as Elder Hua and others.
This was the last stubbornness of this Supreme Elder.
When the sky was completely bright, Xia Yihuo stopped what he was doing, raised his hands and stretched.
Turning around, she saw Qiu Yu still staring at the place where she had been operating before, with a dazed look on her face, her eyes blank, and she entered a philosophical state.
Human saying: In a daze.
Qiu Yu still wanted to read it carefully at first, but this thing was not something he could understand if he looked carefully.
If she couldn't keep up with Xia Yihuo's thinking, her operations would become like a piece of cake that could choke someone to death.
Qiu Yu's current state is that he is choked by his brain, and he is trying to relax his mind by emptying his mind.
"Elder Supreme?" Xia Yihuo said, startling Qiu Yu who was in a daze.
Qiu Yu came back to his senses and pretended to be calm: "Ahem, what's wrong?"
She touched her chin and kept looking at Qiu Yu, making Qiu Yu feel guilty for a while.
"The Supreme Elder was... in a daze just now?" Xia Yihuo said hesitantly, "But didn't the Supreme Elder say that he wanted to watch me carefully and study it? What are you doing?"
"The Supreme Elder won't say that he didn't see my research process again, right?"
Qiu Yu's face turned red. If it weren't for Xia Yihuo's extremely serious expression, he would have thought that this girl was setting him up on purpose.
